title: 第2473章 南明离火第2472章 援军已至
slug: 重生本统子教宿主当老六
content_zh:
席慕海没见过陆沉施展饕风狂龙诀，但那位与柳如意交手的八境强者上次可是参与过围攻陆沉的，那招绞肉机一般的武技让他记忆犹新。
眼见封璃烟那架势和陆沉上次一模一样，他眼中顿时露出了一抹慌乱之色：“席公子，不能让她把这招施展出来，快阻止她！”
见他这般紧张，席慕海也意识到了事情的严重性，当即调集了大量的元力对着封璃烟打出了一条百米长的巨大水龙。
见状，柳如意迅速扇动手中的赤光风火扇，一道炽热的火龙卷当即朝着前方席卷而去。
随着双方激烈地碰撞在一起，瞬间就发生了剧烈的爆炸，一道道强劲的元力波动裹挟着大量的白色蒸汽迅速朝着四周扩散开来。
这让席慕海颇为震惊，水能克火是常识，在同境界下水属性术法大多数时候都能压制住火属性术法。
而且他已经突破到八境六重多年了，而对方显然才突破到八境五重不久，断然没有和他在术法方面平分秋色的道理。
毕竟术法类武技最看重的还是修为和元力储备，而他也不是那种可以被随便越级战胜的货色。
在他不解的同时，那名八境六重的中年男子已经朝着封璃烟斩出了一道凌厉的火焰剑气。
见状，柳如意毫不犹豫地举剑向剑中注入元力，周围的环境立即变得炽热了起来，点点星火迅速在其周身凝聚出来。
随着柳如意一剑挥出，一匹周身燃着烈火的高大骏马当即嘶鸣着朝着那道剑气狂奔而去。
“星悲日祸！”
双方猛烈地碰撞在一起，当场又引发了一场剧烈的爆炸，爆炸的余波裹挟着热浪席卷开来，直接将那名中年男人掀飞了出去。
这下席慕海和那名中年男人全都被震惊到了，因为他们实在想不通柳如意是如何在一眨眼的时间里释放出这般强大的术法的。
他们不知道的是，这全都是焚寂朱雀引的功劳，准确来说应该是她的高阶焚寂朱雀引的功劳。
虽然庚金白虎印也可以加持在术法上，但它的效果主要还是适用于各种技法类的武技，而焚寂朱雀引则恰好与之相反。
原本的焚寂朱雀引只能掏空使用者体内的元力来增强武技的威力，而高阶的效果则是加快元力运转的速度并大幅度提升武技的威力。
虽然这个效果对于技法类的武技同样有效，但技法类武技往往混入了大量的罡气，相对来说还是元力占比更多的术法类武技更能发挥效果。
另外，这个效果也并不是只能作用于自己释放的武技，同样可以通过自己的元力作用在别人释放的武技上以增强其威力。
柳如意常用的那几招传承武技虽然是剑法，但其实它们都是由大量元力凝聚而成的，严格来说它们都属于术法，因此极度适配焚寂朱雀引。

在这种情况下，以席慕海两人的实力，如果他们选择近身与柳如意交战，那柳如意八成不是他们的对手。
可如果是远程释放武技与柳如意对拼，在柳如意的元力耗尽之前，他们是绝无胜算的。
席慕海两人对视了一眼，虽然他们之间没什么默契，但也很快就统一了意见。
只见席慕海再度抬手打出了一条巨大的水龙，柳如意也在第一时间扇动赤光风火扇扇出一道炽热的火龙卷。
在双方碰撞产生爆炸的瞬间，那名中年男人迅速提剑冲向了封璃烟，同时将海量的元力汇聚到了手中的长剑上。
他见识过陆沉施展那招饕风狂龙诀的威力，也知道那种规模的术法在这片战场上能造成多大的影响，所以说什么也不能让封璃烟施展出来。
虽然封璃烟有辟邪青莲台和青光护身凿保护，但他要的只是打断封璃烟释放武技，能不能伤到对方并不重要。
感应到主人有危险，青光护身凿当即化作一道青色流光朝着对方冲了过去，虽然成功将对方击退了，但对方也已经朝着封璃烟斩出了一道剑气。
就在那道剑气即将落在那道保护封璃烟的青色屏障上时，一股炽热的火属性元力忽然在其周围流转了起来。
下一秒，一道赤红色的巨羊虚影悄然浮现出来，那道青色屏障的外围随即凝聚起了一道更大的赤色屏障。
有了这层赤色屏障的保护，那道剑气压根没碰到那道青色屏障，也没对封璃烟造成任何影响。
就在这时，封璃烟的三双羽翼也已经积蓄了足够多的元力，然后便开始朝着东境联盟的大军持续扇动起了翅膀。
由于封璃烟的修为比陆沉低，且她的根基没有陆沉那般扎实到变态的程度，所以她施展出来的饕风狂龙诀的威力会小一些。
但靠着苍龙化雨诀持续恢复元力，她也足足释放出了一百多道百丈高的青色旋风。
见状，柳如意收起手中的赤光风火扇，抬手凝聚起了一道明红色的火焰，然后直接将那团火焰捏散撒向了那些旋风。
这火焰名为南明离火，并地脉流心炎那种灵火，而是像吴幼萱的火焰那样获得传承后得到的特殊火焰。
这南明离火不仅威力绝伦，而且可以点燃结出到的元力，在实战中可以大幅度提升自己和同伴施展的武技的威力。
随着点点火星落在那些青色旋风上，那些旋风当即燃烧了起来，眨眼间就将将东境联盟大军所在的区域变成了一片火海。
虽然那些飞舟都有元力屏障庇护，但那些屏障的强度也是高低不一，很快就有大量的飞舟的屏障被打破了。
面对那些燃烧着的旋风，飞舟上那些修为不足七境的修士哪里抵挡得住，没一会儿就有数千艘飞舟被烧毁了。

虽然那些飞舟上的修士大多逃离了飞舟，但周围此刻已然是一片火海，迎接他们的似乎只剩下死路一条了。

content_en:
Xi Muhai had never seen Lu Chen perform the Tao Feng Mad Dragon Technique, but the Eighth Realm expert who fought against Liu Ruyi had participated in the siege of Lu Chen last time, and the meat grinder-like martial arts technique was still fresh in his memory.
Seeing that Feng Liyan's posture was exactly the same as Lu Chen's last time, a look of panic suddenly appeared in his eyes: "Master Xi, we can't let her use this move, stop her quickly!"
Seeing how nervous he was, Xi Muhai also realized the seriousness of the matter, and immediately mobilized a large amount of energy to shoot a huge water dragon that was 100 meters long at Feng Liyan.
Seeing this, Liu Ruyi quickly fanned the red light wind and fire fan in her hand, and a blazing fire tornado immediately swept forward.
As the two sides collided fiercely, a violent explosion occurred in an instant, and strong energy fluctuations carried a large amount of white steam and quickly spread towards the surroundings.
This shocked Xi Muhai. It is common sense that water can defeat fire. In the same realm, water attribute spells can suppress fire attribute spells most of the time.
Moreover, he has already broken through to the sixth level of the eighth realm for many years, while the opponent has obviously only broken through to the fifth level of the eighth realm not long ago, so there is absolutely no reason why he and he can be equal in terms of spells.
After all, the most important thing in martial arts is cultivation and energy reserves, and he is not the kind of person who can be defeated casually.
While he was puzzled, the middle-aged man at the sixth level of the eighth realm had already slashed a fierce flaming sword energy towards Feng Liyan.
Seeing this, Liu Ruyi raised his sword without hesitation and injected his energy into the sword. The surrounding environment immediately became hot, and little sparks quickly condensed around him.
As Liu Ruyi swung his sword, a tall horse with its whole body burning with fire immediately neighed and ran towards the sword energy.
"The star is sad and the sun is misfortune!"
The two sides collided violently, triggering a violent explosion on the spot. The aftermath of the explosion swept away with a heat wave, directly throwing the middle-aged man away.
Xi Muhai and the middle-aged man were both shocked now, because they really couldn't figure out how Liu Ruyi could release such a powerful spell in the blink of an eye.
What they don't know is that this is all the result of Fenji Suzaku Yin. To be precise, it should be the credit of her high-level Fenji Suzaku Yin.
Although Geng Jin White Tiger Seal can also be used to bless martial arts, its effect is mainly applicable to various martial arts techniques, while Fenji Suzaku Yin is just the opposite.
The original Fenji Suzaku Yin can only drain the energy from the user's body to enhance the power of the martial arts, but the high-level effect is to speed up the movement of the energy and greatly enhance the power of the martial arts.
Although this effect is also effective for technical martial arts, technical martial arts are often mixed with a large amount of Gang Qi. Relatively speaking, technical martial arts with a larger proportion of Yuan Li are more effective.
In addition, this effect does not only apply to the martial arts released by oneself, but can also be used to act on the martial arts released by others through one's own Yuan Power to enhance their power.
Although the inherited martial arts techniques that Liu Ruyi often used were sword techniques, they were actually condensed from a large amount of elemental energy. Strictly speaking, they were all techniques, so they were extremely suitable for Fenji Suzaku Yin.
In this case, with the strength of Xi Muhai and Liu Ruyi, if they choose to fight Liu Ruyi up close, Liu Ruyi will probably not be their opponent.
But if they were to fight Liu Ruyi remotely using martial arts, they would have no chance of winning before Liu Ruyi's energy was exhausted.
Xi Muhai and Xi Muhai looked at each other. Although there was no tacit understanding between them, they quickly came to an agreement.
I saw Xi Muhai raise his hand again and shoot out a huge water dragon, Liu Ruyi also immediately fanned the red light wind and fire fan to create a blazing fire tornado.
At the moment when the two sides collided and exploded, the middle-aged man quickly rushed towards Feng Liyan with his sword, and at the same time gathered a massive amount of energy intoOn the long sword in his hand.
He had seen the power of Lu Chen's Taoist Wind Mad Dragon Technique, and he also knew how much impact a magic of that scale could have on this battlefield, so there was nothing he could do to make Feng Liyan use it.
Although Feng Liyan was protected by the Evil-Repelling Green Lotus Platform and the Green Light Body Chisel, all he wanted was to interrupt Feng Liyan from releasing his martial arts. It didn't matter whether he could hurt the opponent or not.
Sensing that the master was in danger, the green light body chisel immediately turned into a stream of blue light and rushed towards the opponent. Although he successfully repelled the opponent, the opponent had already slashed a sword energy towards Feng Liyan.
Just when the sword energy was about to fall on the cyan barrier protecting Feng Liyan, a blazing fire-attributed energy suddenly began to flow around it.
The next second, a crimson giant sheep silhouette quietly emerged, and an even larger red barrier formed around the cyan barrier.
With the protection of this red barrier, the sword energy did not touch the cyan barrier at all, nor did it have any impact on Feng Liyan.
At this moment, Feng Liyan's three pairs of wings had accumulated enough energy, and then they began to flap their wings towards the Eastern Alliance army.
Since Feng Liyan's cultivation level is lower than Lu Chen's, and her foundation is not as solid as Lu Chen's, so the power of the Tao Feng Kuang Dragon Technique she performs will be smaller.
But relying on the Canglong Rain Transformation Technique to continuously restore her energy, she also released more than a hundred cyan whirlwinds that were a hundred feet high.
Seeing this, Liu Ruyi put away the red light wind and fire fan in her hand, raised her hand to condense a bright red flame, and then directly pinched the flame and scattered it towards the whirlwind.
This flame is called Nanming Lihuo, and it is not a spiritual fire like the Earthly Meridian Liuxinyan, but a special flame obtained after being inherited like Wu Youxuan's flame.
This Nanming Lihuo is not only extremely powerful, but can also ignite the formed Yuanli, which can greatly enhance the power of the martial arts performed by oneself and his companions in actual combat.
As little sparks fell on those green whirlwinds, those whirlwinds immediately burned, turning the area where the Eastern Alliance army was into a sea of ​​fire in the blink of an eye.
Although those flying boats were protected by Yuanli barriers, the strength of those barriers varied, and soon a large number of flying boats' barriers were broken.
Facing those burning whirlwinds, the monks on the flying boats who were less than the seventh level of cultivation could not withstand it. In a short while, thousands of flying boats were burned down.
Although most of the monks on the flying boat escaped from the flying boat, the surroundings were already a sea of ​​fire, and there seemed to be only a dead end to greet them.
